title: Native immutable-image ELF execution manifest with pinned application trust
description: Data only, not execution permission. Exact canonical ASCII JSON with no LF, at most 32768 bytes. The eight v1 fields plus required nonnull applicationTrust; the explicit combined client v6 selects v2, while client v5 retains v1. The actual owner verifies the immutable in-image file and genuine native CA association; a schema, readonly mount or environment string alone cannot establish that an application uses this trust.

environment.description: Complete explicit environment under the unchanged bounds and loader-variable exclusions. SSL_CERT_FILE must equal applicationTrust.path; this exact cross-field equality is enforced by the native owner, not by JSON Schema. No ambient environment or writable image trust is inherited.

applicationTrust.description: Exactly one canonical runtime-CA PEM inside the retained immutable image, 64..65536 bytes, root:root and mode 0444 or 0644; decoded DER at most 16384 bytes. The path must differ from the entry and any interpreter path. These actual filesystem/content and cross-field checks are runtime obligations, not facts proved by this object. The entire PEM and DER certificate have separately pinned nonzero SHA-256 digests.
